items.title: Protecting Apache Iceberg Lakehouses at Scale with Rubrik on AWS
items.summary: Apache Iceberg is now a standard open table format for AWS lakehouses, and because that data feeds AI pipelines and financial reporting, it needs stronger protection. Recovering a working table takes more than restoring files, because it depends on consistent metadata, manifests and catalog. Rubrik's new Apache Iceberg Data Protection on AWS backs up the full table to the customer's AWS account or Rubrik Cloud Vault, then updates the catalog on recovery so the table is immediately queryable. The post explains why native time travel alone falls short and how Rubrik and AWS bring enterprise cyber resilience to the lakehouse.
